Subject: Novus AI risk questionnaire - initial submission

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is our enterprise AI risk questionnaire and a brief template where we map vendor responses to our internal acceptance criteria. Can Redwood confirm:

- How you map to NIST AI RMF core functions (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage, and Govern again)?
- Whether Redwood considers the hosted API or private (VPC) deployment to be the recommended route for high-risk clinical triage scenarios under EU AI Act?
- What continuous regression/eval tooling you ship for model quality drift (metrics, cadence, and sample tooling)?

We're on a tight timeline for our procurement committee — would appreciate an initial structured response by EOD 2027-05-20.

Regards,
Sofia
Head of AI Risk, Novus Health

Date: 2027-05-12T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Novus AI risk questionnaire - initial submission

Hi Sofia,

Thanks — we've started a section-by-section mapping to your questionnaire. High-level summary up front:

1) NIST AI RMF mapping: we provide a downloadable RMF mapping matrix that ties Redwood controls to the NIST functions (Identify/Protect/Detect/Respond/Recover mapped to Redwood's model lifecycle controls and runtime protections).

2) EU AI Act posture: for "high-risk" clinical triage use, we recommend Private (VPC) deployment combined with our Dedicated offering and an in-scope conformity assessment plan. Hosted API is possible with contractual and configuration guardrails but for high-risk classification customers typically choose Private + Dedicated.

3) Continuous eval/regression: Redwood Optimize includes continuous evaluation pipelines: daily sampling, automated regression alerts (per-prompt metrics), canary rollouts, and automatic fallback to safe baseline models on regression breach. We include an eval harness (Python + CI templates) and example metric sets (accuracy, calibration, hallucination rate by prompt slice, fairness deltas).

I'll attach the completed questionnaire and RMF mapping matrix for your review. Marcus and Neha are looped in for technical and legal details. If this aligns, we'll prepare a short annex describing required evidence for a conformity assessment.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Novus_Risk_Questionnaire_Completed_20270520.pdf, RMF-mapping-matrix-Redwood.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-15T10:21:00Z
Subject: Re: Novus AI risk questionnaire - initial submission

Irene — quick technical notes / suggested clarifications before we send back to Novus:

- On NIST mapping, call out which runtime mitigations are enforced vs configurable by customer (e.g., prefix/KV caching is runtime-opt not a security control; token redaction & PII scrubbers are shipped and configurable).
- EU AI Act: add explicit note about data controller/processor responsibilities when customers run private deployments in their VPC versus using Redwood Hosted (we must not imply we accept controller status for customer data unless contractually agreed).
- Continuous eval: include concrete thresholds/examples: e.g., if hallucination_rate increases >5% relative to baseline across the target prompt set for 3 consecutive days -> automatic canary halt and notifications to customer. Also mention sampling bias checks and slice-based fairness metrics (demographic parity delta).

I'll mark these in the RMF spreadsheet and append a short example CI workflow for the eval harness.

-Marcus
Principal Infra Engineer, Runtime

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Novus AI risk questionnaire - initial submission

Team — legal/compliance guidance to include in the external response:

- For EU AI Act high-risk classification: we should present a two-path approach in the reply: (A) Minimum compliance posture (hosted + contractual safeguards + enhanced logging) for PoC-only scenarios; (B) Full conformity posture (Private/Dedicated + conformity evidence + third-party assessment) for production clinical triage. Provide an estimated timeline and list of evidence items (SRS, model cards, dataset provenance summary, logging retention, changelog for model updates, CI eval reports).
- Privacy & data flows: include KMS integration options (customer-managed keys), data-at-rest encryption specifics for Private, and our recommended retention policies for audit logs to satisfy typical conformity assessment bodies.
- Attach evidence stubs: SOC2 summary, sample model card, and an eval-run export (anonymized).

I'll also add a short paragraph about our regression alert SLAs and who owns remediations.

-Neha
Senior Counsel, Compliance

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Petrov <sofia@novushealth.com>, Lars Bjornsen <lars.b@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-20T16:48:00Z
Subject: Re: Novus AI risk questionnaire - initial submission

Sofia / Lars — thank you for the patience. Attached is our structured response to your questionnaire plus an annex that explains how our controls map to NIST AI RMF and how Redwood supports EU AI Act conformity pathways. Key highlights (TL;DR):

- RMF mapping: downloadable matrix attached; we map Redwood operational controls (model versioning, dataset provenance tracking, eval harness, CI pipelines, audit logging, KMS, RBAC) to the NIST functions and provide example evidence artifacts.
- EU AI Act posture: for "high-risk" clinical triage we recommend (and many customers choose) Private + Dedicated + third-party conformity assessment. For customers that must start faster, we outline a documented interim hosted configuration with contractual obligations and enhanced telemetry. The response includes an estimated 12-16 week timeline for a full conformity pathway (sampled evidence, third-party audit prep).
- Continuous eval/regression: Redwood Optimize includes an eval harness (open templates), daily sample jobs, slice-aware metrics (accuracy, calibration, hallucination rate, parity deltas), a regression policy (example threshold included), and automated canary rollouts with immediate rollback and notifications. We included a sample CI workflow showing an automated regression alert leading to a canary halt and a fallback to a validated baseline model.

Attachments: Novus_Risk_Questionnaire_Completed_20270520.pdf, RMF-mapping-matrix-Redwood.xlsx, evidence-SOC2-summary-Redwood.pdf

Next steps I propose:
1) Review the attached package and call out any gaps by 2027-05-27.
2) If you want, we can run a short 60-minute technical walkthrough focused on RMF mapping and the eval CI templates (we can record the session).
3) For conformity assessment planning, Marcus and Neha can provide a minimal evidence list and an estimated resource plan.

Happy to jump on a call this week.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
